notes.deferred_vocab_columns: categorical columns whose vocabulary the design does NOT tokenize are intentionally NOT in design_locked_enums (no guessed enum); values stay typed strings until forward-calibrated — gap_policy(§13 #13) / structure_quality(§13 #24, field-name list only) / min_rr_gate_status+post_round_rr_status(§13 #16, field-name list only) / cash_allocation_status(§13 #25, field-name list only) / symbol_cooldown_status(§13 #23, field-name list only) / macro_cluster_size_adjustment(§13 #31, NUMERIC reduction amount) / selection_bucket / live_size_warning. Verified by exhaustive design re-sweep: these carry NO design value vocabulary (only field-name lists / numerics / free tags / prose).
notes.design_vocab_two_conventions: the design locks a column vocabulary via TWO equivalent conventions — `field ∈ {v1, v2}` AND `` `field`（v1 / v2）`` (incl. `词表：` lists). theme_source(§4.3 l148: gics_established/provisional_discovered) and macro_cluster_warning_level(§8 l228: none/elevated/high — only the frac thresholds are §13 #31 forward, labels are locked) use the parenthetical form and ARE pinned. The test sweeps BOTH conventions for coverage.
notes.one_glance_table: §11.3 精简一眼表 (~8 cols) is a weekly_report rendering projection of these columns, not a separate csv contract; deferred to batch-3 renderer
notes.scope: declarative output contract only — freezes the §11.3 column set/order + design-locked column vocabularies; no row produced, no engine run, no data fetch, no A-share crossing. Runtime row validation (no-dangling / evidence-traceback) is batch-3 and CONSUMES this contract.
